rows: Every crypto exchange CCXT supports, with name, countries and key capabilities

rows.vgi.doc_llm: One row per exchange CCXT supports: the `id` every other function takes, display name, countries, CCXT certification, rate limit, website and whether it supports candles, trades, funding-rate history and open interest. No network request. Use it to find exchange ids and to choose venues for derivatives queries, for example `WHERE has_funding_rate_history`. Country and capability data are CCXT's; an exchange may still refuse requests from your region.
rows.vgi.doc_md:
## exchanges

A table: every CCXT exchange id with its name, countries and capabilities. Offline.

Every call is a live request from your machine to the exchange's public API. Nothing is cached or redistributed by this worker; you are the API caller, and each exchange's terms of use and geographic restrictions apply to you (for example, Binance.com refuses US IP addresses).
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "Exchanges that publish both funding history and open interest", "sql": "SELECT id, name FROM ccxt.main.exchanges WHERE has_funding_rate_history AND has_open_interest ORDER BY id"}, {"description": "The ten countries listed for the most exchanges", "sql": "SELECT unnest(countries) AS country, count(*) AS exchanges FROM ccxt.main.exchanges GROUP BY country ORDER BY exchanges DESC LIMIT 10"}]
rows.vgi.result_columns_schema: [{"name": "id", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "CCXT exchange id: the value every other function takes."}, {"name": "name", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "Display name, e.g. 'Kraken'."}, {"name": "countries", "type": "VARCHAR[]", "description": "ISO country codes CCXT lists for the exchange."}, {"name": "certified", "type": "BOOLEAN", "description": "Whether CCXT marks the integration as certified."}, {"name": "pro", "type": "BOOLEAN", "description": "Whether CCXT Pro supports the exchange over WebSockets."}, {"name": "rate_limit_ms", "type": "DOUBLE", "description": "Minimum spacing CCXT keeps between requests, in milliseconds."}, {"name": "website", "type": "VARCHAR", "description": "The exchange's home page."}, {"name": "has_ohlcv", "type": "BOOLEAN", "description": "Whether ohlcv works on this exchange."}, {"name": "has_trades", "type": "BOOLEAN", "description": "Whether trades works on this exchange."}, {"name": "has_funding_rate_history", "type": "BOOLEAN", "description": "Whether funding_rates works on this exchange."}, {"name": "has_open_interest", "type": "BOOLEAN", "description": "Whether open_interest works on this exchange."}]
rows.vgi.title: Supported Exchanges

rows: CREATE TABLE exchanges(id VARCHAR, "name" VARCHAR, countries VARCHAR[], certified BOOLEAN, pro BOOLEAN, rate_limit_ms DOUBLE, website VARCHAR, has_ohlcv BOOLEAN, has_trades BOOLEAN, has_funding_rate_history BOOLEAN, has_open_interest BOOLEAN, PRIMARY KEY(id));
